nodes.description: Public mapping of token balances indexed by address.
Public token name string.
Public token symbol string.
Public token decimals (18).
Public total supply of tokens minted at deployment.
Nested public mapping of owner to spender allowances.
Public function named differently from the contract PolyusCdsTok20220328II; therefore NOT a constructor in 0.4.21 and callable by anyone to set their own balance to totalSupply.
Public function transferring tokens from msg.sender to a recipient.
Public function setting allowance[msg.sender][spender].
Public function transferring tokens using an allowance.
Caller-controlled address used as the sender and as a mapping key.
Miner-influenced timestamp; not referenced anywhere in this contract.
Transaction origin; not referenced anywhere in this contract.
Recipient address parameter of transfer.
Amount parameter of transfer.
Spender address parameter of approve.
Amount parameter of approve.
Source address parameter of transferFrom.
Destination address parameter of transferFrom.
Amount parameter of transferFrom.
Boolean return variable declared in transfer, approve and transferFrom.
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= value in transfer; unchecked sub in 0.4.21 but guarded by require.
balanceOf[to] += value in transfer; unchecked addition can overflow.
allowance[msg.sender][spender] = value in approve; unchecked assignment.
balanceOf[from] -= value in transferFrom; guarded subtraction.
balanceOf[to] += value in transferFrom; unchecked addition can overflow.
allowance[from][msg.sender] -= value in transferFrom; guarded subtraction.

edges.reason: Any external msg.sender can call SimpleERC20Token() because it is not a constructor (name differs from contract name), setting balanceOf[msg.sender] = totalSupply and minting the whole supply to the attacker.
msg.sender is used as the key into the balanceOf mapping.
totalSupply is assigned into balanceOf for the caller.
SimpleERC20Token writes balanceOf[msg.sender].
SimpleERC20Token reads totalSupply to assign the initial balance.
msg.sender supplies the source balance in transfer.
to parameter flows into transfer.
value parameter flows into transfer.
transfer writes balanceOf entries for sender and recipient.
transfer reads balanceOf[msg.sender] in its require check.
value parameter is subtracted from the sender balance.
transfer executes the checked subtraction on balanceOf[msg.sender].
transfer executes the unchecked addition to balanceOf[to].
value parameter is added to the recipient balance.
to parameter indexes the balanceOf addition target.
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve.
spender parameter flows into approve.
value parameter flows into approve.
approve writes the allowance mapping.
value parameter is stored into allowance.
approve executes the unchecked allowance assignment.
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is consumed in transferFrom.
from parameter flows into transferFrom.
to parameter flows into transferFrom.
value parameter flows into transferFrom.
transferFrom reads and writes balanceOf for from and to.
transferFrom reads balanceOf[from] in its require check.
transferFrom reads and decrements the allowance mapping.
transferFrom reads allowance[from][msg.sender] in its require check.
value parameter is subtracted from balanceOf[from].
transferFrom executes the checked subtraction on balanceOf[from].
transferFrom executes the unchecked addition to balanceOf[to].
transferFrom executes the checked subtraction on the allowance.
value parameter is subtracted from the spender allowance.
